Context about the conversation (domain, names, terms) to improve transcription; describe the content, do not give instructions. Leave empty unless needed. At most 1750 characters.
- `remove_disfluencies` (Boolean) Available only for speechmatics/linden-1. When true, filler words such as "um" and "uh" are removed from the transcript. Disfluency removal is supported only for `ar`, `cmn`, `da`, `de`, `el`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `he`, `hi`, `hu`, `it`, `ja`, `nl`, `pl`, `pt`, and `ru`, determined by the base language (so `en-US`, `en-GB`, `en-AU`, `cmn-Hans`, and `cmn-Hant` are supported); for other languages, filler words remain in the transcript.
- `smart_format` (Boolean)



<a id="nestedatt--voice_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `voice_settings`

Optional:

- `api_key_ref` (String) The `identifier` for an integration secret [/v2/integration_secrets](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/integration-secrets/create-a-secret) that refers to your ElevenLabs API key. Warning: Free plans are unlikely to work with this integration.
- `background_audio` (Attributes) Optional background audio to play on the call. Use a predefined media bed, or supply a looped MP3 URL. If a media URL is chosen in the portal, customers can preview it before saving. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--voice_settings--background_audio))
- `expressive_mode` (Boolean) Enables emotionally expressive speech using SSML emotion tags. When enabled, the assistant uses audio tags like angry, excited, content, and sad to add emotional nuance. Only supported for Telnyx Ultra voices.
- `language_boost` (String) Enhances recognition for specific languages and dialects during MiniMax TTS synthesis. Default is null (no boost). Set to 'auto' for automatic language detection. Only applicable when using MiniMax voices. One of `Afrikaans`, `Arabic`, `Bulgarian`, `Catalan`, `Chinese`, `Chinese,Yue`, `Croatian`, `Czech`, `Danish`, `Dutch`, `English`, `Filipino`, `Finnish`, `French`, `German`, `Greek`, `Hebrew`, `Hindi`, `Hungarian`, `Indonesian`, `Italian`, `Japanese`, `Korean`, `Malay`, `Norwegian`, `Nynorsk`, `Persian`, `Polish`, `Portuguese`, `Romanian`, `Russian`, `Slovak`, `Slovenian`, `Spanish`, `Swedish`, `Tamil`, `Thai`, `Turkish`, `Ukrainian`, `Vietnamese`, `auto`.
- `similarity_boost` (Number) Determines how closely the AI should adhere to the original voice when attempting to replicate it. Only applicable when using ElevenLabs.
- `speed` (Number) Adjusts speech velocity. 1.0 is default speed; values less than 1.0 slow speech; values greater than 1.0 accelerate it. Only applicable when using ElevenLabs.
- `style` (Number) Determines the style exaggeration of the voice. Amplifies speaker style but consumes additional resources when set above 0. Only applicable when using ElevenLabs.
- `temperature` (Number) Determines how stable the voice is and the randomness between each generation. Lower values create a broader emotional range; higher values produce more consistent, monotonous output. Only applicable when using ElevenLabs.
- `tool_call_audio` (Attributes) Optional sound played to the caller while the assistant runs a tool (for example a webhook or MCP tool). It replaces the background audio until the tool responds, then the background audio resumes. Defaults to null, which plays no sound; send `null` on update to clear it. Not played in conference calls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--voice_settings--tool_call_audio))
- `use_speaker_boost` (Boolean) Amplifies similarity to the original speaker voice. Increases computational load and latency slightly. Only applicable when using ElevenLabs.
- `voice` (String) The voice to be used by the voice assistant. Check the full list of [available voices](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/tts-stt/tts-available-voices) via our voices API. To use ElevenLabs, you must reference your ElevenLabs API key as an integration secret under the `api_key_ref` field. See [integration secrets documentation](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/integration-secrets/create-a-secret) for details. For Telnyx voices, use `Telnyx.<model_id>.<voice_id>` (e.g. Telnyx.KokoroTTS.af_heart). For Soniox voices, use `Soniox.tts-rt-v2.<voice_id>` (e.g. Soniox.tts-rt-v2.Emma); every Soniox voice speaks all supported languages. The voice portion of the identifier supports [dynamic variables](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/inference/ai-assistants/dynamic-variables) using mustache syntax (e.g. `Telnyx.Ultra.{{voice_id}}`). The variable is resolved at call time from your dynamic variables webhook, allowing you to select the voice dynamically per call.
- `voice_speed` (Number) The speed of the voice in the range [0.6, 1.5]. 1.0 is the default speed. Larger numbers make the voice faster, smaller numbers make it slower. Applies to Telnyx `Ultra` voices; values outside this range are rejected by the synthesis engine. Soniox voices support a speed range of 0.7 to 1.3.

<a id="nestedatt--voice_settings--background_audio"></a>
### Nested Schema for `voice_settings.background_audio`

Optional:

- `type` (String) One of `media_name`, `media_url`, `predefined_media`.
- `value` (String) The `name` of a media asset created via [Media Storage API](https://developers.telnyx.com/api/media-storage/create-media-storage). The audio will loop during the call.
- `volume` (Number) Volume level for the predefined background audio. Supports values from 0.1 to 1.0 in 0.1 increments.


<a id="nestedatt--voice_settings--tool_call_audio"></a>
### Nested Schema for `voice_settings.tool_call_audio`

Optional:

- `type` (String) One of `media_url`, `predefined_media`.
- `value` (String) HTTPS URL to an MP3 file.
- `volume` (Number) Volume level for the predefined media. Supports values from 0.0 to 1.0 in 0.1 increments. `0.0` plays no sound.



<a id="nestedatt--websocket_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `websocket_settings`

Optional:

- `auth_ref` (String) Integration secret identifier whose value Telnyx sends as an `Authorization: Bearer <value>` header on the upgrade request. Resolved on every connection attempt, so a rotated secret is picked up by the next reconnect.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Telnyx opens a WebSocket to `url` for each of this assistant's conversations. Defaults to `false`.
- `url` (String) The `ws://` or `wss://` endpoint Telnyx connects to. Required when `enabled` is `true`. Must be externally reachable — localhost, private IP ranges and `.local` domains are rejected.


<a id="nestedatt--widget_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widget_settings`

Optional:

- `agent_thinking_text` (String) Text displayed while the agent is processing.
- `audio_visualizer_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widget_settings--audio_visualizer_config))
- `default_state` (String) The default state of the widget. One of `collapsed`, `expanded`.
- `give_feedback_url` (String) URL for users to give feedback.
- `logo_icon_url` (String) URL to a custom logo icon for the widget.
- `position` (String) The positioning style for the widget. One of `fixed`, `static`.
- `report_issue_url` (String) URL for users to report issues.
- `speak_to_interrupt_text` (String) Text prompting users to speak to interrupt.
- `start_call_text` (String) Custom text displayed on the start call button.
- `theme` (String) The visual theme for the widget. One of `dark`, `light`.
- `view_history_url` (String) URL to view conversation history.

<a id="nestedatt--widget_settings--audio_visualizer_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widget_settings.audio_visualizer_config`

Optional:

- `color` (String) The color theme for the audio visualizer. One of `bloom`, `flare`, `glacier`, `mystic`, `twilight`, `verdant`.
- `preset` (String) The preset style for the audio visualizer.



<a id="nestedatt--import_metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `import_metadata`

Read-Only:

- `import_id` (String) ID of the assistant in the provider's system.
- `import_provider` (String) Provider the assistant was imported from.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_ai_assistant.example <id>
```
